main.description: Private Catbird surface (blue.catbird.labyrinth.*), not an ATProto or community-ratified lexicon. The erasable recovery shares this service holds for the caller's DID, without share bytes. Clients compare it with their recovery methods: a method whose share is missing cannot be restored, and a share whose method was proven removed can be deleted. Mailbox endpoint on the caller's home DS. Requires an active, non-revoked chat device of the caller DID, proven by the account-bound service JWT and a signed device request. A pending chat device may not store, delete or list shares; the clean-slate service has no Labyrinth-device binding table. Common errors: NotAuthorized, AccountSessionExpired, DeviceRevoked, RateLimited, InvalidRequest, PayloadTooLarge.

shareView.description: Private Catbird surface (blue.catbird.labyrinth.*), not an ATProto or community-ratified lexicon. One stored share, described without its bytes.

vdeviceId.description: Recovery bundle (virtual device) id: the 16-byte vid derived from the recovery code, equal to the bundle's record key in hex.

mechanism.description: Which recovery method the share belongs to: a typed recovery code, or a recovery code wrapped by a passkey.

createdByDeviceId.description: Chat device that stored the share.

fetchCount.description: Successful share reads other than the creator's first verify read within ten minutes of put; later purpose-verify reads are counted as fetches.
